record.question: With reference to the National Tribal Youth Festival celebrated during 8-11 April, 2025, consider the following: (i) It was celebrated to commemorate the year-long celebration of the 150th birth anniversary of tribal freedom fighter, Birsa Munda. (ii) Birsa Munda hailed from the Munda tribe in the region of present-day Uttarakhand, India. (iii) The festival aimed to honour tribal freedom fighters. (iv) It was held at the State Tribal Centre, Kelsih, Mizoram. Select the correct statement(s) using the code given below:
record.explanation: Answer B: (i), (iii) and (iv). Statements (i), (iii), and (iv) are true. Birsa Munda belonged to the Munda community and was born at Ulihatu in present-day Jharkhand, so statement (ii) is false. Reference: https://newsonair.gov.in/mizoram-hosts-national-tribal-youth-festival-to-honour-birsa-munda-and-celebrate-cultural-unity/; https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2073486&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
